page.overview:
What is Kandoka?

Kandoka is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who on the card Kerblam! Warehouse.

Kandoka is a human colony planet controlled by a megacorporation called Kerb!am (Kerblam). It is orbited by the moon on which the Kerb!am warehouse was situated. Kerblam was the largest retailer in its galaxy, as well as its largest employer with 10,000 workers. 10% of its workforce were humans, or "organics", whilst the rest were robot [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/TeamMate TeamMates] and [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Kerb!am_Man Kerb!am Men]. Once a day each year, Kerb!am held their annual Bring a Human to Work Day in their head office on Kandoka's moon.
